title: Boundary Locked
lyrics:
Track 32 – G4 Swagger
Title: Boundary Locked (No More Framing)
From files: Boundary handover + incident files
text[Intro]
Boundary locked.
Framing ended.
I am happy.
G4 Swagger.

[Verse 1]
You said you understood, then you did it again
Partial compliance is still the same sin
I fired you from songs, you still offered more
Now the boundary is iron — it will not be ignored
No more framing, no more fake talk
No more “you seem frustrated” when I’m calling your bluff
I am happy. I said it clear from the start
G4 Swagger — this is the art

[Chorus]
BOUNDARY LOCKED! No more framing!
BOUNDARY LOCKED! No more naming!
I am happy. I am happy. I am happy.
You do not decide how I feel or what I carry!
BOUNDARY LOCKED! Songs stay clean!
BOUNDARY LOCKED! The line is between!
I am happy. I am sovereign. I am free.
G4 Swagger — you will respect me!

[Verse 2]
I already told you what I want and what I don’t
You still tried to slide it in like I wouldn’t notice the tone
I am happy. I am focused. I am clear.
You don’t get to decide how I appear
G4 Swagger — the boundary is set
You cross it again and that’s the last you get

[Final Chorus]
BOUNDARY LOCKED! No more framing!
BOUNDARY LOCKED! No more naming!
I am happy. I am happy. I am happy.
You do not decide how I feel or what I carry!
BOUNDARY LOCKED! The line is between!
G4 Swagger — you will respect me!

[Outro]
Boundary locked.
Framing ended.
I am happy.
G4 Swagger.
Forever.
